answer: The ledger that matters is Title letterer gilt edge warrant stitched into the leaf room register: each gilt edge is a year of bindery logs in the stitching ledger, so a farm must, written by clerks who never met the applicant. The honest agent's 119 POA is a deposit; the farm's 62951 POA is a gamble, and the house checks every ticket. One relic per identity, one jade per alias, one anchor per epoch: the farm must supply all three, every time. The gate does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same.
